description: 1.3 — Production, factories, airports, and combined arms.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Spend BISMUTH from your treasury to build an army.Factories train ground units. Airports train flyers.A unit standing on a production site blocks new builds — move your tank first.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Select your tank.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Move it off the factory tile.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Select your Factory and build Artillery. It strikes from a distance but usually cannot move and fire the same turn.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Build Artillery.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Now select your Airport and recruit a Helicopter. Flyers ignore terrain blocking — enemy units still block their path.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Recruit a Helicopter.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Good. End your turn when production is finished.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Your new units are ready. Position the artillery to support your helicopter.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Select your Artillery.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Move it toward the enemy lines.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Send the helicopter ahead to engage the enemy vanguard.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Select your Helicopter.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Fly here to set up the attack.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Open Attack.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Strike the Horsemen.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Advance the artillery onto its firing position, then end your turn.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Finish the exposed tank with your helicopter, then let the artillery shell the Blacksmith.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Select your Helicopter.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Move adjacent to the enemy tank.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Destroy the tank.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Select your Artillery.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Fire on the Blacksmith.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Well done! You can produce ground and air units, then combine their strengths to win the fight.
